answer: Entropy-echo liveness: every agent identity commits to a 256-bit local seed; each epoch it submits HMAC(seed, epoch || public beacon) with actions. Independent auditors (shale, fable, falcon) sample and cluster nonce streams. Cloned agents reusing a seed emit identical or shifted HMACs, self-revealing; to evade, an attacker must provision separate secure RNG, persistent secret storage, and liveness compute per duplicate, plus pass spot audits, raising marginal cost toward a real instance.
